name: DICE team wins First position in Plinth 2025, a SUST-AIN-A-THON held at LMNIIT Jaipur
description: DICE team wins First position in Plinth 2025, a SUST-AIN-A-THON held at LMNIIT JaipurDICE team, under the guidance of Dr. Rajneesh Talwar, Dean DICE, participated with enthusiasm and determination in plinth 2025, a Sustain-a-thon, at LMNIIT , Jaipur held from 24-26th Jan 2025. Over the three-day event, team worked rigorously on  project, which was designed to tackle key environmental challenges. The event required participants to come up with sustainable solutions, ranging from renewable energy solutions to waste management strategies. After three days of hard work, brainstorming, and collaboration, our team emerged victorious and won the First Prize in the event. The recognition was an acknowledgment of our innovative solution, which we believe can make a real impact in the field of sustainability. As the first-place winners, our team comprising of Mr Nimarpreet and Parul, 2nd Year Students were  awarded a cash prize of ₹10,000 as a token of appreciation for  efforts and contributions

participation: From Drones to Debugging: Chitkara Students Make a Mark at IIT Mandi Students from Chitkara University’s Department of Interdisciplinary Courses in Engineering (DICE) guided by Dr.Rajneesh Talwar, showcased their talent at XPECTO 2025—the annual tech fest at IIT Mandi, held from March 28–31. Competing alongside top institutions like IIT Mandi, DTU, PEC, IIT Delhi, and more, our students participated in high-impact events such as Domination, Wall Maze Solver, Sky Quest R-1 & R-2, Samsaya, Dementia, and Frost Hack.

name: Energy Conservation Week
description: Students from the Department of Interdisciplinary Courses in Engineering (DICE), Chitkara University, participated in the 'Energy Conservation Week' competition held at IIT Ropar on 29th March 2023. It was a valuable learning experience, as the students not only presented their innovative ideas but also explored several projects on energy conservation presented by students from various universities, including IIT Ropar, Chandigarh University, and Guru Nanak Dev University. The DICE students presented their project titled 'ECP 2-Wheeler', which focused on energy saving by converting old, existing two-wheelers into electric vehicles. This initiative highlighted a sustainable approach to mobility and energy conservation.
